## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
      (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...) - the release version is derived from it
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass

- [ ] No credentials, tokens or personal data appear in the diff or fixtures
